basis: Workload weights and completed points are engineering judgments based on the approved scope and current implementation/evidence register. They are not counts of features, migrations, commits or passing tests. The full approved backend remains unfinished.

groups.name: Production hardening, privacy, backups and live verification

revisionRule: Keep the backend-only scope and effort weighting consistent. Explain and record any reassessment; do not silently switch to whole-product progress or feature counting. Update verified acceptance separately in backend-work.json. No estimate can establish live-service verification or goal completion.
